# Aditya Birla + GrowthBook
Date: 2026-09-17 | Duration: 37.619998931884766m

## Summary
The team is evaluating a centralized experimentation platform for 15 brands, with active testing across 10 to 11 mostly custom platforms and future Shopify use. Adobe Target currently supports advanced client-side tests, including UI changes, popups, upsell and cross-sell widgets, personalized content, and cross-domain content retrieval. The team also has a server-side experimentation pilot on React Native apps and plans to support server-side web testing. Key requirements include cross-domain session, cart, and wishlist synchronization; backend pre-evaluation using flexible IDs; and integration with Adobe Analytics, GA4, BigQuery, and Adobe Experience Platform. Growth Book was presented as a potential Adobe Target replacement, supported by positive sister-brand experience, client-side and server-side SDKs, visual editing, cross-website experiments, and enterprise scalability. Pricing discussed was US$200,000 annually for self-hosted or US$250,000 for cloud, plus US$1,250 per internal user annually. A 45-minute Enterprise demo will cover setup, integrations, workflows, and pricing.

## Keywords
experiment platform, client-side experimentation, server-side experimentation, Adobe Target, multi-brand eCommerce, GrowthBook pricing
